summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026, furnishing a press release that serves as an update and logistics notice for its Capital Markets Day on September 16, 2026, at the Sofitel New York. The event covers Blanket Mine production performance, the Bilboes gold project development and funding strategy, exploration and expansion pipeline, and capital allocation priorities. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor mandate, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is an investor-relations scheduling communication, not a special situation; watch for operational or project guidance at the event.
